title: overlay_pixels_frame re-inlines the BGRA readback normalization instead of calling the same-package swizzle_rb helper
evidence:
harness/overlay.odin:269-274 (new proc):
	img := rl.LoadImageFromScreen()
	rl.ImageFlipVertical(&img)
	px := rl.LoadImageColors(img)
	n := int(img.width) * int(img.height)
	for i in 0..<n {
		px[i].r, px[i].b = px[i].b, px[i].r
	duplicates harness/goldens.odin:129-133:
swizzle_rb :: proc(img: ^rl.Image) {
	px := rl.LoadImageColors(img^)
	n := int(img.width) * int(img.height)
	for i in 0..<n {
		px[i].r, px[i].b = px[i].b, px[i].r
	}
while the same file already calls the helper (harness/overlay.odin:76-78):
	img := rl.LoadImageFromScreen()
	rl.ImageFlipVertical(&img)
	swizzle_rb(&img)
detail: Verbatim-copy drift risk — the exact class this diff's own W4/W7 dedup cites ("three verbatim copies... the drift class that already bit once"). app/gallery.odin gallery_shot adds a third copy cross-package.
recommended_fix: Call swizzle_rb in overlay_pixels_frame; hoist it to app/render so gallery_shot shares one normalization proc.
